targets.authors: Duran, P., Kammerlander, N., Van Essen, M., & Zellweger, T.
targets.title: Doing more with less: Innovation input and output in family firms.
targets.evidence_quote: Our study sought to replicate DKEZ and extend their study by updating the dataset of primary studies, applying a more advanced approach that considers multilevel structures in meta-analytic data, and adding firm age as a missing control.
targets.outcome_quote: The results show that while we could successfully replicate the original results of DKEZ in study 1, study 2 revealed only a weak negative effect of family firm status on innovation input and no effect on innovation output.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit successful Study 1 and unsuccessful central output comparison in Study 2; input comparison still agrees.
